seoTitle: How to Connect a Hostinger Domain to Shopify
metaDescription: Point your Hostinger domain to Shopify by updating A and CNAME records in the DNS Zone Editor, then verify the connection in Shopify admin.
intro: If you registered your domain through Hostinger but want to run your store on Shopify, you'll need to manually update your DNS settings to connect the two. This guide covers editing the A record and CNAME record in Hostinger's DNS Zone Editor, then verifying the domain inside Shopify.

steps.heading: Check your Shopify domain settings
steps.body: In Shopify admin, note the domain connection details you'll need for the DNS update.

steps.heading: Log into Hostinger hPanel
steps.body: Access your Hostinger account and open hPanel to manage your domain.

steps.heading: Find the DNS Zone Editor
steps.body: Navigate to the DNS Zone Editor where your domain's records are managed.

steps.heading: Update the A record
steps.body: Remove the old A record and add Shopify's IP address in its place.

steps.heading: Set up the CNAME record
steps.body: Configure the www CNAME record so it points correctly to your Shopify store.

steps.heading: Verify the domain in Shopify
steps.body: Return to Shopify admin to confirm the domain connection, keeping in mind that DNS changes can take time to propagate and SSL may show as pending initially.

faq.question: How long does it take for the domain to connect?
faq.answer: DNS propagation can take anywhere from a few minutes to 48 hours, so it's normal for the SSL status to show as pending right after the change.

faq.question: Do I need to remove my old A record before adding the new one?
faq.answer: Yes, removing the existing A record before adding Shopify's IP address helps prevent conflicts in the DNS Zone Editor.

faq.question: What if my domain shows as not connected after updating DNS?
faq.answer: Double-check that both the A record and CNAME record were updated correctly, and allow time for DNS propagation before troubleshooting further.

faq.question: Can I use a domain purchased from Hostinger with Shopify without transferring it?
faq.answer: Yes, you can keep the domain registered with Hostinger and simply point its DNS records to Shopify rather than transferring the domain itself.
